Zoran Milanović ( Croatian: [zǒran milǎːnoʋitɕ] ⓘ ; [ 2 ] born 30 October 1966) is a Croatian politician who is the current president of Croatia . First elected in 2020, he was re-elected in 2025 with 74% voter support. [ 3 ] Prior to assuming the presidency, he was the prime minister of Croatia from 2011 to 2016, as well as the president of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) from 2007 to 2016.
